entities.span: Thicken the search segment: seniority, remote or hybrid, job type, salary range, and listing recency, on top of the title and location already there. The underlying source already supports most of these; the gap in the reference project was its own implementation. There is no structured remote field, so remote is handled by a text heuristic over title and description for now.
**Done when:** each filter changes the result set as stated,
filter state is reflected in the URL so a search is shareable and survives a reload,
the remote heuristic's limits are visible to the user rather than presented as certain,
and a repeat search does not wipe the visible results.

Owes a decision on what a repeat view costs, recorded from spec 0013 on 2026-09-04. The last **Done when** clause, "a repeat search does not wipe the visible results", is the one at risk, and nothing today satisfies it. Feature 11 measured, against a production build, that every request carrying `q` or `where` spends one gate check and one Adzuna call: a reload, a shared link and a **browser back navigation** alike. There is no client side cache, so returning to a result set costs budget every time, against an account cap of 25 a week. So this feature has to decide what a repeat view costs, whether that is holding results through a filter change without refetching or accepting a fresh gated call each time, and each filter added multiplies the question.
Do not test this under `pnpm dev`, which makes back navigation look free for a development only reason spec 0013's Consequences explains.
